 Preliminary 2.6 magnitude earthquake strikes near San Jose 
 By NBC Bay Area staff • 
 Published 5 hours ago • 
 Updated 5 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Are you prepared for the next big one? 
 A preliminary 2.6 magnitude earthquake struck near San Jose Tuesday afternoon, according to the United States Geological Survey .
 The quake hit at 12:38 p.m. and was centered 9 miles east of Seven Trees, 9 miles east-southeast of Alum Rock and 9.8 miles east of Communications Hill, the USGS said.
